NewsArticle.Title: Songs of the Shrine
NewsArticle.Content: Prayer Supplication/Entreaty offers an option to receive 3-9 Songs of the Shrine. These songs may already be made by wizards. The advantage is that the song is guaranteed to go to the nearest village by the shrine. The greater the worshipper's faith, the more songs that will be obtained. - Deoch: Suomi Song - Glioca: Mileth Song - Cail: Undine Song - Luathas: Rucesion Song - Gramail: Loures Song - Fiosachd: Abel Song - Ceannlaidir: Piet Song - Sgrios: Rucesion Song Rucesion is the nearest village to the Sgrios shrine. See a priest of shrine near the listed town to join a religion and learn about other of the 200+ total unique miracles and social activities of the religion. A song that goes directly inside the shrine would cause havoc with trying to banish someone from a shrine or from a village. All prayer effectiveness and faith effect are determined by fuzzy mechanics; therefore, allow tendencies toward miracles instead of guaranteed miracles and self-regulate a worshipper's long-term faith. See [religious](http://www.darkages.com/play/s_religion.html) and [all](http://www.darkages.com/pics/index_feature.html) features screenshots.
